name: aidlc-unknowns
description: Find the unknowns before they get expensive. Two cheap pre-implementation stages — a blindspot pass that scouts what the human does not know they do not know, and an evaluation calibration that raises the human's ability to judge a domain BEFORE a downstream gate asks them to approve work in it — plus contributions that add the symmetric over-specification check to requirements/design and a conservative-deviation rule to code generation. Distilled, with attribution, from Thariq Shihipar's essay 'A field guide to Claude Fable 5: Finding your unknowns'.
